stem.text: Silicon reacts with a mixture of calcium oxide and magnesium oxide at $1200\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
Which statement about this reaction is correct?

A.text: Calcium is reduced and silicon is neither oxidised nor reduced.

B.text: Magnesium is reduced and calcium is neither oxidised nor reduced.

C.text: Magnesium is reduced and silicon is neither oxidised nor reduced.

D.text: Silicon is reduced and calcium is neither oxidised nor reduced.
